local function v58()
    local v89 = CurrentCamera:ScreenPointToRay(CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X / 2, CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()

    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { LocalPlayer.Character }

    local raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(v89.Origin, v89.Direction * 1000, raycastParams)
    local v92 = raycastResult

    if raycastResult then
        v92 = raycastResult.Instance:IsA("BasePart")

        if v92 then
            v92 = not raycastResult.Instance.Anchored
        end
    end

    if v92 then
        return raycastResult.Instance, raycastResult.Position
    end

    return nil, nil
end
local function v59(p4)
    if not p4 or not p4.Parent then
        return false
    end

    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

    if not Character then
        return false
    end

    local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not HumanoidRootPart then
        return false
    end

    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()

    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Whitelist
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { p4 }

    return workspace:Raycast(HumanoidRootPart.Position, Vector3.new(0, -5, 0), raycastParams) ~= nil
end
local function v60(p5)
    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

    if not Character or u18 then
        return
    end

    local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not HumanoidRootPart then
        return
    end

    if WeldConstraint then
        pcall(function()
            WeldConstraint:Destroy()
        end)
    end

    WeldConstraint = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
    WeldConstraint.Part0 = HumanoidRootPart
    WeldConstraint.Part1 = p5
    WeldConstraint.Parent = HumanoidRootPart
    u18 = true
    pcall(function()
        for _, descendant in pairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                descendant.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end)
end
local function v61()
    if WeldConstraint then

    u18 = false

        for _, descendant in pairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                descendant.CanCollide = true
            end
        end
    end
end

local t6 = {
	minus = false,
	plus = false
}
local t7 = {
	minus = false,
	plus = false
}
local t8 = {
	x = t6,
	y = t7,
	z = {
		minus = false,
		plus = false
	}
}
local t9 = {
	minus = nil,
	plus = nil
}
local t10 = {
	minus = nil,
	plus = nil
}
local t11 = {
	x = t9,
	y = t10,
	z = {
		minus = nil,
		plus = nil
	}
}
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
for _, v in pairs(t2) do
    local v74 = string.lower(v)

    t5[v].MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        t11[v74].minus = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        t8[v74].minus = true
    end)
    t5[v].MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
        t8[v74].minus = false
        t11[v74].minus = nil
    end)
    t4[v].MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        t11[v74].plus = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        t8[v74].plus = true
    end)
    t4[v].MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
        t8[v74].plus = false
        t11[v74].plus = nil
    end)
end
TextButton10.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local v106 = u7

    if v106 then
        v106 = u7.Parent
    end

    if v106 then
        t1 = {
			x = 0,
			y = 0,
			z = 0
		}

        for _, v in pairs(t2) do
            t3[v].Text = v .. ": 0°"
        end

        v62()
    end
end)
TextButton6.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
    u13 = true
end)
TextButton6.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
    u13 = false
end)
TextButton7.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
    u14 = true
end)
TextButton7.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
    u14 = false
end)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not u6 then
        return
    end

    if u13 then
        n1 = math.max(0, n1 - 0.3)
        TextLabel2.Text = "距离：" .. math.floor(n1)
    end

    if u14 then
        n1 += 0.3
        TextLabel2.Text = "距离：" .. math.floor(n1)
    end

    for _, v in pairs(t2) do
        local v111 = string.lower(v)
        local minus = t8[v111].minus

        if minus then
            minus = t11[v111].minus
        end

        if minus and (UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - t11[v111].minus).Magnitude > 10 then
            t8[v111].minus = false
        end

        local plus = t8[v111].plus

        if plus then
            plus = t11[v111].plus
        end

        if plus and (UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - t11[v111].plus).Magnitude > 10 then
            t8[v111].plus = false
        end

        local v114 = t8[v111]

        if v114 then
            v114 = t8[v111].minus
        end

        if v114 then
            t1[v111] = t1[v111] - 1.5

            if t1[v111] < 0 then
                t1[v111] = 360 + t1[v111]
            end

            t3[v].Text = v .. ": " .. math.floor(t1[v111]) .. "°"
            v62()
        end

        local v115 = t8[v111]

        if v115 then
            v115 = t8[v111].plus
        end

        if v115 then
            t1[v111] = t1[v111] + 1.5

            if t1[v111] >= 360 then
                t1[v111] = 0
            end

            t3[v].Text = v .. ": " .. math.floor(t1[v111]) .. "°"
            v62()
        end
    end
end)
TextButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Frame.Visible = false
    TextButton3.Visible = true
end)
TextButton3.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Frame.Visible = true
    TextButton3.Visible = false
end)
TextButton2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    v64()

    if u9 then
        u9:Disconnect()
    end

    ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    v64()

    if u9 then
        u9:Disconnect()
    end
end)
